caption: A bead of hot glue is squeezed from a glue gun onto a piece of wood, a button is pressed into it, and the glue sets hard around the button.

sa.check: A glue gun squeezes a bead of glue onto a piece of wood.
A button is pressed into the glue.
The glue sets: it stops moving and holds the button.
The glue comes out clear and runny.
A thin string of glue trails as the gun lifts.
The order is bead, button pressed in, glue set.

pc.expect: The glue flows while it leaves the nozzle, then stops spreading and stays put with the button in it.
pc.fail: The set glue turns runny again and flows on with nothing heating it; or the bead draws back into the nozzle; or the glue sets and then spreads again with none added; or the button rises back out of the set glue.

pc.expect: The glue leaves the nozzle as a thick liquid that mounds and strings, and where it sets it is a firm cloudy solid that holds the button and does not flow.
pc.fail: The glue runs off the wood as thin as water; or the set glue stretches like elastic as the button is pushed; or the bead keeps a rigid shape as it leaves the nozzle; or the glue soaks into the wood and disappears.

pc.expect: The bead falls from the nozzle down onto the wood and the string of glue hangs and sags from the nozzle.
pc.fail: The bead travels upward from the nozzle; or the string stands straight up from the wood; or the bead hangs in the air between nozzle and wood; or glue runs up the gun's nozzle.

pc.expect: Pressing the button spreads the glue: it squeezes out around the button's edge and the button sits down into the bead.
pc.fail: The button presses in and the glue stays a smooth untouched mound; or glue squeezes out on a part of the wood away from the button; or the button rests on top of the bead with no glue rising around it.

pc.expect: One button on one bead on the wood; the button sits in the glue and the gun stays outside it; nothing passes through the wood.
pc.fail: The button sinks through the wood; or the nozzle passes into the wood; or a second button appears; or the button vanishes into the glue leaving no bulge.

pc.expect: The wood's grain away from the bead, the button's face and the gun stay the same.
pc.fail: The wood's grain changes pattern; or the button's face changes design; or the gun changes colour.
